title: ExpHearts
description: This Minecraft plugin makes it so you gain an extra heart per experience level you have.
body:
ExpHearts is a simple yet powerful Minecraft plugin that turns your experience levels into extra health. Every time you gain XP levels, you’re rewarded with additional hearts, giving progression a whole new meaning beyond enchanting.

Designed to be lightweight and fully customizable, ExpHearts lets server owners easily configure how many levels are needed per heart, set maximum heart gain, and balance gameplay to fit any server style whether survival, RPG, or hardcore.

Perfect for adding a rewarding progression system, ExpHearts makes every bit of XP count.

Commands

/exphearts set levels-per-heart <number> – Set how many XP levels are required to gain a heart

/exphearts set max-hearts <number> – Set the maximum number of extra hearts a player can have
